newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler, GM not told yet who is next UAW target.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler, GM not told yet who is next UAW target.

text.p: The United Auto Workers union has not notified Chrysler Corp or General Motors Corp which one of the automakers will be the second negotiating target in this year's bargaining for a new labor contract, company representatives said Monday.

Earlier Monday, the Canadian Auto Workers announced it selected GM as its next bargaining stop. CAW President Buzz Hargrove said at a news conference he is certain the UAW will not pick GM as its next target, suggesting that Chrysler will be next on the UAW's list.
"We have not received any word yet from the UAW who the next company is," said Chrysler spokeswoman Nicole Solomon.

The UAW and Ford Motor Co reached a tentative agreement September 16. Ratification of that agreement is expected by September 29. On Sunday, CAW members ratified a new labor agreement with Chrysler's Canadian unit.
The UAW has not said which of the Detroit Big Three it will talk to next. A UAW spokeswoman could not be reached for comment Monday morning.
Analysts have generally said the UAW and CAW will not talk to the same company at the same time.
